publication: Anne Burberry, Edition and Analysis of Twenty-Five Unpublished Aramaic Magic Bowl Texts in the Collection of the Vorderasiatisches Museum (Berlin) (PhD thesis, University of Exeter, 2020)

inspection.method: PDF metadata and full text-layer inspection, with rendered visual checks of title and rights matter, contents, first and last catalogue entries, the ACB 19 fragment boundary, glossary boundary, photograph boundary, and terminal photograph page.
inspection.printed_and_pdf_pagination: The numbered PDF pages and printed page numbers coincide for the catalogue and edition section.
inspection.catalogue_section: Presentation of New Bowl Texts begins on page 109; ACB 1 begins on page 110 and ACB 25 begins on page 342; glossaries begin on page 346 and photographs on page 457.
inspection.terminal_check: Page 477 is the final photograph page and shows ACB 24 and ACB 25, confirming the expected terminal object sequence.

scope.acb_19_boundary: ACB 19 (VAN 13391) is described on page 313 as two small non-joining rim fragments. Fragment A and Fragment B on pages 314-315 are those two edited pieces within ACB 19, not additional edition units.
scope.reconciliation_policy: Attach each appearance only to the unique existing Berlin-catalogue object carrying the same complete inventory designation. Preserve VA versus VA Bab. prefixes and suffix b; do not use the bare number where multiple namespaces exist. No identity merge is required.
scope.extraction_policy: Record catalogue-level source appearances, the ACB publication key, inventory designation, publication status, and reported language only. Do not reproduce transcription, translation, philological notes, commentary, drawings, photographs, or personal-name data.

rights.handling: The repository PDF remains in the private hash-addressed archive. No protected scholarly expression or image is copied into the public corpus layer and no public-release decision is made.
